content.stem:
A company runs a public-facing three-tier web application in a VPC across multiple Availability Zones. Amazon EC2 instances for the application tier running in private subnets need to download software patches from the internet. However, the EC2 instances cannot be directly accessible from the internet. Which actions should be taken to allow the EC2 instances to download the needed patches? (Select TWO.)

一家公司在跨多个可用区的 VPC 中运行面向公众的三层 Web 应用程序。在私有子网中运行的应用层的 Amazon EC2 实例需要从互联网下载软件补丁。但是，无法从 Internet 直接访问 EC2 实例。应采取哪些操作来允许 EC2 实例下载所需的补丁？ （选择两项。）
content.expl:
A NAT gateway forwards traffic from the EC2 instances in the private subnet to the internet or other AWS services, and then sends the response back to the instances. After a NAT gateway is created, the route tables for private subnets must be updated to point internet traffic to the NAT gateway.

NAT 网关将流量从私有子网中的 EC2 实例转发到互联网或其他 AWS 服务，然后将响应发送回实例。创建 NAT 网关后，必须更新私有子网的路由表，以将 Internet 流量指向 NAT 网关。

content.text.0:
Configure a NAT gateway in a public subnet.

在公有子网中配置 NAT 网关。

Define a custom route table with a route to the NAT gateway for internet traffic and associate it with the private subnets for the application tier.

定义一个自定义路由表，其中包含到 Internet 流量的 NAT 网关的路由，并将其与应用程序层的私有子网关联。

Assign Elastic IP addresses to the EC2 instances.

为 EC2 实例分配弹性 IP 地址。

Define a custom route table with a route to the internet gateway for internet traffic and associate it with the private subnets for the application tier.

定义一个自定义路由表，其中包含到 Internet 流量的 Internet 网关的路由，并将其与应用程序层的私有子网关联。

Configure a NAT instance in a private subnet.

在私有子网中配置 NAT 实例。

content.stem:
A solutions architect wants to design a solution to save costs for Amazon EC2 instances that do not need to run during a 2-week company shutdown. The applications running on the EC2 instances store data in instance memory that must be present when the instances resume operation. Which approach should the solutions architect recommend to shut down and resume the EC2 instances?

解决方案架构师想要设计一个解决方案，以节省在公司停工 2 周期间不需要运行的 Amazon EC2 实例的成本。 EC2 实例上运行的应用程序将数据存储在实例内存中，当实例恢复运行时这些数据必须存在。解决方案架构师应建议采用哪种方法来关闭和恢复 EC2 实例？
content.expl:
Hibernating EC2 instances save the contents of instance memory to an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) root volume. When the instances restart, the instance memory contents are reloaded.

休眠 EC2 实例将实例内存的内容保存到 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 根卷。当实例重新启动时，实例内存内容将重新加载。

content.text.0:
Modify the application to store the data on instance store volumes. Reattach the volumes while restarting them.

修改应用程序以将数据存储在实例存储卷上。重新启动卷时重新附加它们。

Snapshot the EC2 instances before stopping them. Restore the snapshot after restarting the instances.

在停止 EC2 实例之前对其进行快照。重启实例后恢复快照。

Run the applications on EC2 instances enabled for hibernation. Hibernate the instances before the 2- week company shutdown.

在启用休眠功能的 EC2 实例上运行应用程序。在公司关闭两周之前使实例休眠。

Note the Availability Zone for each EC2 instance before stopping it. Restart the instances in the same Availability Zones after the 2-week company shutdown.

在停止之前记下每个 EC2 实例的可用区。公司关闭两周后，重新启动同一可用区中的实例。

content.stem:
A company plans to run a monitoring application on an Amazon EC2 instance in a VPC. Connections are made to the EC2 instance using the instance’s private IPv4 address. A solutions architect needs to design a solution that will allow traffic to be quickly directed to a standby EC2 instance if the application fails and becomes unreachable. Which approach will meet these requirements?

某公司计划在 VPC 中的 Amazon EC2 实例上运行监控应用程序。使用实例的私有 IPv4 地址与 EC2 实例建立连接。解决方案架构师需要设计一种解决方案，以便在应用程序发生故障且无法访问时能够将流量快速定向到备用 EC2 实例。哪种方法可以满足这些要求？
content.expl: A secondary elastic network interface can be added to an EC2 instance. While primary network interfaces cannot be detached from an instance, secondary network interfaces can be detached and attached to a different EC2 instance.

content.text.0:
Deploy an Application Load Balancer configured with a listener for the private IP address and register the primary EC2 instance with the load balancer. Upon failure, de-register the instance and register the standby EC2 instance.

部署配置了私有 IP 地址侦听器的 Application Load Balancer，并向负载均衡器注册主 EC2 实例。失败时，取消注册实例并注册备用 EC2 实例。

Configure a custom DHCP option set. Configure DHCP to assign the same private IP address to the standby EC2 instance when the primary EC2 instance fails.

配置自定义 DHCP 选项集。配置 DHCP，以便在主 EC2 实例出现故障时为备用 EC2 实例分配相同的私有 IP 地址。

Attach a secondary elastic network interface to the EC2 instance configured with the private IP address. Move the network interface to the standby EC2 instance if the primary EC2 instance becomes unreachable.

将辅助弹性网络接口连接到配置有私有 IP 地址的 EC2 实例。如果主 EC2 实例变得无法访问，请将网络接口移至备用 EC2 实例。

Associate an Elastic IP address with the network interface of the primary EC2 instance. Disassociate the Elastic IP from the primary instance upon failure and associate it with a standby EC2 instance. AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (SAA-C03) Sample Exam Questions © 2022, Amazon Web Services, Inc. or its affiliates. All rights reserved | aws.amazon.com 2 | P a g e

将弹性 IP 地址与主 EC2 实例的网络接口关联。发生故障时，将弹性 IP 与主实例解除关联，并将其与备用 EC2 实例关联。 AWS 认证解决方案架构师 - 助理 (SAA-C03) 考试题示例 © 2022，Amazon Web Services, Inc. 或其附属公司。版权所有| aws.amazon.com 2 |页

content.stem:
An analytics company is planning to offer a web analytics service to its users. The service will require that the users’ webpages include a JavaScript script that makes authenticated GET requests to the company’s Amazon S3 bucket. What must a solutions architect do to ensure that the script will successfully execute?

一家分析公司正计划为其用户提供网络分析服务。该服务将要求用户的网页包含一个 JavaScript 脚本，该脚本向公司的 Amazon S3 存储桶发出经过身份验证的 GET 请求。解决方案架构师必须做什么才能确保脚本成功执行？
content.expl:
Web browsers will block running a script that originates from a server with a domain name that is different from the webpage. Amazon S3 can be configured with CORS to send HTTP headers that allow the script to run.

Web 浏览器将阻止运行源自域名与网页不同的服务器的脚本。 Amazon S3 可以配置 CORS 以发送允许脚本运行的 HTTP 标头。

content.text.0:
Enable cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) on the S3 bucket.

在 S3 存储桶上启用跨源资源共享 (CORS)。

Enable S3 Versioning on the S3 bucket.

在 S3 存储桶上启用 S3 版本控制。

Provide the users with a signed URL for the script.

向用户提供脚本的签名 URL。

Configure an S3 bucket policy to allow public execute privileges.

配置 S3 存储桶策略以允许公共执行权限。

content.stem:
A company’s security team requires that all data stored in the cloud be encrypted at rest at all times using encryption keys stored on premises. Which encryption options meet these requirements? (Select TWO.)

公司的安全团队要求使用本地存储的加密密钥始终对存储在云中的所有数据进行静态加密。哪些加密选项满足这些要求？ （选择两项。）
content.expl:
Server-side encryption with customer-provided keys (SSE-C) enables Amazon S3 to encrypt objects on the server side using an encryption key provided in the PUT request. The same key must be provided in the GET requests for Amazon S3 to decrypt the object. Customers also have the option to encrypt data on the client side before uploading it to Amazon S3, and then they can decrypt the data after downloading it. AWS software development kits (SDKs) provide an S3 encryption client that streamlines the process.

使用客户提供的密钥进行服务器端加密 (SSE-C) 使 Amazon S3 能够使用 PUT 请求中提供的加密密钥来加密服务器端的对象。必须在 Amazon S3 的 GET 请求中提供相同的密钥才能解密对象。客户还可以选择在将数据上传到 Amazon S3 之前在客户端加密数据，然后在下载数据后解密数据。 AWS 软件开发工具包 (SDK) 提供了可简化流程的 S3 加密客户端。

content.text.0:
Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3).

使用带有 Amazon S3 托管加密密钥 (SSE-S3) 的服务器端加密。

Use server-side encryption with AWS KMS managed encryption keys (SSE-KMS).

使用带有 AWS KMS 托管加密密钥 (SSE-KMS) 的服务器端加密。

Use server-side encryption with customer-provided encryption keys (SSE-C).

使用带有客户提供的加密密钥的服务器端加密 (SSE-C)。

Use client-side encryption to provide at-rest encryption.

使用客户端加密来提供静态加密。

Use an AWS Lambda function invoked by Amazon S3 events to encrypt the data using the customer’s keys.

使用 Amazon S3 事件调用的 AWS Lambda 函数来使用客户密钥加密数据。

content.stem:
A company uses Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances to run its data processing workload. The nightly job typically takes 7 hours to run and must finish within a 10-hour time window. The company anticipates temporary increases in demand at the end of each month that will cause the job to run over the time limit with the capacity of the current resources. Once started, the processing job cannot be interrupted before completion. The company wants to implement a solution that would provide increased resource capacity as cost-effectively as possible. What should a solutions architect do to accomplish this?

一家公司使用 Amazon EC2 预留实例来运行其数据处理工作负载。每晚作业通常需要 7 小时才能运行，并且必须在 10 小时的时间窗口内完成。该公司预计每个月底需求会暂时增加，这将导致该工作超出当前资源容量的时间限制。一旦开始，处理作业在完成之前就不能中断。该公司希望实施一种解决方案，以尽可能经济高效的方式提供更高的资源容量。解决方案架构师应该做什么来实现这一目标？
content.expl:
While Spot Instances would be the least costly option, they are not suitable for jobs that cannot be interrupted or must complete within a certain time period. On-Demand Instances would be billed for the number of seconds they are running.

虽然 Spot 实例是成本最低的选项，但它们不适合无法中断或必须在特定时间段内完成的作业。按需实例将根据其运行的秒数进行计费。

content.text.0:
Deploy On-Demand Instances during periods of high demand.

在高需求期间部署按需实例。

Create a second EC2 reservation for additional instances.

为其他实例创建第二个 EC2 预留。

Deploy Spot Instances during periods of high demand.

在高需求期间部署 Spot 实例。

Increase the EC2 instance size in the EC2 reservation to support the increased workload. AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (SAA-C03) Sample Exam Questions © 2022, Amazon Web Services, Inc. or its affiliates. All rights reserved | aws.amazon.com 3 | P a g e

增加 EC2 预留中的 EC2 实例大小以支持增加的工作负载。 AWS 认证解决方案架构师 - 助理 (SAA-C03) 考试题示例 © 2022，Amazon Web Services, Inc. 或其附属公司。版权所有| aws.amazon.com 3 |页

content.stem:
A company runs an online voting system for a weekly live television program. During broadcasts, users submit hundreds of thousands of votes within minutes to a front-end fleet of Amazon EC2 instances that run in an Auto Scaling group. The EC2 instances write the votes to an Amazon RDS database. However, the database is unable to keep up with the requests that come from the EC2 instances. A solutions architect must design a solution that processes the votes in the most efficient manner and without downtime. Which solution meets these requirements?

一家公司为每周的直播电视节目运行在线投票系统。在广播期间，用户在几分钟内向 Auto Scaling 组中运行的 Amazon EC2 实例前端队列提交数十万张选票。 EC2 实例将投票写入 Amazon RDS 数据库。但是，数据库无法跟上来自 EC2 实例的请求。解决方案架构师必须设计一个能够以最有效的方式处理投票且无需停机的解决方案。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？
content.expl:
Decouple the ingestion of votes from the database to allow the voting system to continue processing votes without waiting for the database writes. Add dedicated workers to read from the SQS queue to allow votes to be entered into the database at a controllable rate. The votes will be added to the database as fast as the database can process them, but no votes will be lost.

将投票的摄取与数据库解耦，以允许投票系统继续处理投票，而无需等待数据库写入。添加专门的工作人员从 SQS 队列中读取数据，以允许以可控的速率将选票输入数据库。选票将按照数据库处理它们的速度添加到数据库中，但不会丢失任何选票。

content.text.0:
Migrate the front-end application to AWS Lambda. Use Amazon API Gateway to route user requests to the Lambda functions.

将前端应用程序迁移到 AWS Lambda。使用 Amazon API Gateway 将用户请求路由到 Lambda 函数。

Scale the database horizontally by converting it to a Multi-AZ deployment. Configure the front-end application to write to both the primary and secondary DB instances.

通过将数据库转换为多可用区部署来水平扩展数据库。配置前端应用程序以写入主数据库实例和辅助数据库实例。

Configure the front-end application to send votes to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Provision worker instances to read the SQS queue and write the vote information to the database.

配置前端应用程序以将投票发送到 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。配置工作实例以读取 SQS 队列并将投票信息写入数据库。

Use Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) to create a scheduled event to re-provision the database with larger, memory optimized instances during voting periods. When voting ends, re-provision the database to use smaller instances.

使用 Amazon EventBridge（Amazon CloudWatch 事件）创建计划事件，以便在投票期间为数据库重新配置更大的内存优化实例。投票结束后，重新配置数据库以使用较小的实例。

content.stem:
A company has a two-tier application architecture that runs in public and private subnets. Amazon EC2 instances running the web application are in the public subnet and an EC2 instance for the database runs on the private subnet. The web application instances and the database are running in a single Availability Zone (AZ). Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to provide high availability for this architecture? (Select TWO.)

一家公司拥有在公共子网和私有子网中运行的两层应用程序体系结构。运行 Web 应用程序的 Amazon EC2 实例位于公有子网中，数据库的 EC2 实例在私有子网中运行。 Web 应用程序实例和数据库在单个可用区 (AZ) 中运行。解决方案架构师应采取哪些步骤组合来为此架构提供高可用性？ （选择两项。）
content.expl:
Create new subnets in a new Availability Zone (AZ) to provide a redundant network. Create an Auto Scaling group with instances in two AZs behind the load balancer to ensure high availability of the web application and redistribution of web traffic between the two public AZs. Create an RDS DB instance in the two private subnets to make the database tier highly available too.

在新的可用区 (AZ) 中创建新子网以提供冗余网络。创建一个 Auto Scaling 组，其中实例位于负载均衡器后面的两个可用区中，以确保 Web 应用程序的高可用性以及两个公共可用区之间 Web 流量的重新分配。在两个私有子网中创建一个 RDS 数据库实例，以使数据库层也具有高可用性。

content.text.0:
Create new public and private subnets in the same AZ.

在同一可用区中创建新的公有子网和私有子网。

Create an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group and Application Load Balancer spanning multiple AZs for the web application instances.

为 Web 应用程序实例创建跨多个可用区的 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组和 Application Load Balancer。

Add the existing web application instances to an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer.

将现有 Web 应用程序实例添加到 Application Load Balancer 后面的 Auto Scaling 组。

Create new public and private subnets in a new AZ. Create a database using an EC2 instance in the public subnet in the new AZ. Migrate the old database contents to the new database.

在新的可用区中创建新的公有子网和私有子网。使用新可用区的公有子网中的 EC2 实例创建数据库。将旧数据库内容迁移到新数据库。

Create new public and private subnets in the same VPC, each in a new AZ. Create an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance in the private subnets. Migrate the old database contents to the new DB instance. 在同一 VPC 中创建新的公有子网和私有子网，每个子网位于一个新的可用区中。在私有子网中创建 Amazon RDS 多可用区数据库实例。将旧数据库内容迁移到新数据库实例。 AWS 认证解决方案架构师 - 助理 (SAA-C03) 考试题示例 © 2022，Amazon Web Services, Inc. 或其附属公司。版权所有| aws.amazon.com 4 |页

content.stem:
A website runs a custom web application that receives a burst of traffic each day at noon. The users upload new pictures and content daily, but have been complaining of timeouts. The architecture uses Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling groups, and the application consistently takes 1 minute to initiate upon boot up before responding to user requests. How should a solutions architect redesign the architecture to better respond to changing traffic?

某个网站运行一个自定义 Web 应用程序，该应用程序每天中午都会收到大量流量。用户每天都会上传新的图片和内容，但一直抱怨超时。该架构使用 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组，并且应用程序在启动时始终需要 1 分钟才能响应用户请求。解决方案架构师应该如何重新设计架构以更好地响应不断变化的流量？
content.expl:
The current configuration puts new EC2 instances into service before they are able to respond to transactions. This could also cause the instances to overscale. With a step scaling policy, you can specify the number of seconds that it takes for a newly launched instance to warm up. Until its specified warm-up time has expired, an EC2 instance is not counted toward the aggregated metrics of the Auto Scaling group. While scaling out, the Auto Scaling logic does not consider EC2 instances that are warming up as part of the current capacity of the Auto Scaling group. Therefore, multiple alarm breaches that fall in the range of the same step adjustment result in a single scaling activity. This ensures that you do not add more instances than you need.

当前配置将新的 EC2 实例投入使用，然后才能响应事务。这也可能导致实例规模过大。通过逐步扩展策略，您可以指定新启动的实例预热所需的秒数。在指定的预热时间到期之前，EC2 实例不会计入 Auto Scaling 组的聚合指标中。横向扩展时，Auto Scaling 逻辑不会将正在预热的 EC2 实例视为 Auto Scaling 组当前容量的一部分。因此，同一步长调整范围内的多个警报违规会导致一次伸缩活动。这可确保您添加的实例不会超出您的需要。

content.text.0:
Configure a Network Load Balancer with a slow start configuration.

使用慢启动配置配置 Network Load Balancer。

Configure Amazon ElastiCache for Redis to offload direct requests from the EC2 instances.

为 Redis 配置 Amazon ElastiCache 以卸载来自 EC2 实例的直接请求。

Configure an Auto Scaling step scaling policy with an EC2 instance warmup condition.

配置具有 EC2 实例预热条件的 Auto Scaling 步骤扩展策略。

Configure Amazon CloudFront to use an Application Load Balancer as the origin.

配置 Amazon CloudFront 以使用 Application Load Balancer 作为源。

content.stem:
An application running on AWS uses an Amazon Aurora Multi-AZ DB cluster deployment for its database. When evaluating performance metrics, a solutions architect discovered that the database reads are causing high I/O and adding latency to the write requests against the database. What should the solutions architect do to separate the read requests from the write requests?

在 AWS 上运行的应用程序为其数据库使用 Amazon Aurora 多可用区数据库集群部署。在评估性能指标时，解决方案架构师发现数据库读取导致高 I/O 并增加针对数据库的写入请求的延迟。解决方案架构师应该如何将读取请求与写入请求分开？
content.expl:
Aurora Replicas provide a way to offload read traffic. Aurora Replicas share the same underlying storage as the main database, so lag time is generally very low. Aurora Replicas have their own endpoints, so the application will need to be configured to direct read traffic to the new endpoints.

Aurora 副本提供了一种卸载读取流量的方法。 Aurora 副本与主数据库共享相同的底层存储，因此延迟时间通常非常短。 Aurora 副本有自己的端点，因此需要配置应用程序以将读取流量定向到新端点。

content.text.0:
Enable read-through caching on the Aurora database.

在 Aurora 数据库上启用读取缓存。

Update the application to read from the Multi-AZ standby instance.

更新应用程序以从多可用区备用实例读取。

Create an Aurora replica and modify the application to use the appropriate endpoints.

创建 Aurora 副本并修改应用程序以使用适当的终端节点。

Create a second Aurora database and link it to the primary database as a read replica. AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (SAA-C03) Sample Exam Questions © 2022, Amazon Web Services, Inc. or its affiliates. All rights reserved | aws.amazon.com 5 | P a g e

content.stem:
Your website is serving on-demand training videos to your workforce. Videos are uploaded monthly in high resolution MP4 format. Your workforce is distributed globally often on the move and using company-provided tablets that require the HTTP Live Streaming (HLS) protocol to watch a video. Your company has no video transcoding expertise and it required you may need to pay for a consultant. How do you implement the most cost-efficient architecture without compromising high availability and quality of video delivery?

您的网站正在为您的员工提供点播培训视频。视频每月以高分辨率 MP4 格式上传。您的员工分布在全球各地，经常在移动中使用公司提供的平板电脑，这些平板电脑需要 HTTP 直播流 (HLS) 协议才能观看视频。您的公司没有视频转码专业知识，因此您可能需要付费聘请顾问。如何在不影响视频传输的高可用性和质量的情况下实施最具成本效益的架构？

content.text.0:
A video transcoding pipeline running on EC2 using SQS to distribute tasks and Auto Scaling to adjust the number of nodes depending on the length of the queue. EBS volumes to host videos and EBS snapshots to incrementally backup original files after a few days. CloudFront to serve HLS transcoded videos from EC2.

在 EC2 上运行的视频转码管道，使用 SQS 分配任务，并使用 Auto Scaling 根据队列长度调整节点数量。用于托管视频的 EBS 卷和用于在几天后增量备份原始文件的 EBS 快照。 CloudFront 提供来自 EC2 的 HLS 转码视频。

Elastic Transcoder to transcode original high-resolution MP4 videos to HLS. EBS volumes to host videos and EBS snapshots to incrementally backup original files after a few days. CloudFront to serve HLS transcoded videos from EC2.

Elastic Transcoder 可将原始高分辨率 MP4 视频转码为 HLS。用于托管视频的 EBS 卷和用于在几天后增量备份原始文件的 EBS 快照。 CloudFront 提供来自 EC2 的 HLS 转码视频。

Elastic Transcoder to transcode original high-resolution MP4 videos to HLS. S3 to host videos with Lifecycle Management to archive original files to Glacier after a few days. CloudFront to serve HLS transcoded videos from S3.

Elastic Transcoder 可将原始高分辨率 MP4 视频转码为 HLS。 S3 通过生命周期管理托管视频，以便在几天后将原始文件存档到 Glacier。 CloudFront 提供来自 S3 的 HLS 转码视频。

A video transcoding pipeline running on EC2 using SQS to distribute tasks and Auto Scaling to adjust the number of nodes depending on the length of the queue. S3 to host videos with Lifecycle Management to archive all files to Glacier after a few days. CloudFront to serve HLS transcoded videos from Glacier.

在 EC2 上运行的视频转码管道，使用 SQS 分配任务，并使用 Auto Scaling 根据队列长度调整节点数量。 S3 通过生命周期管理托管视频，以便在几天后将所有文件存档到 Glacier。 CloudFront 提供来自 Glacier 的 HLS 转码视频。

content.stem:
You are designing an intrusion detection prevention (IDS/IPS) solution for a customer web application in a single VPC. You are considering the options for implementing IOS IPS protection for traffic coming from the Internet. Which of the following options would you consider? (Choose 2 answers)

您正在为单个 VPC 中的客户 Web 应用程序设计入侵检测防御 (IDS/IPS) 解决方案。您正在考虑对来自 Internet 的流量实施 IOS IPS 保护的选项。您会考虑以下哪些选项？ （选择 2 个答案）

content.text.0:
Implement IDS/IPS agents on each Instance running in VPC.

在 VPC 中运行的每个实例上实施 IDS/IPS 代理。

Configure an instance in each subnet to switch its network interface card to promiscuous mode and analyze network traffic.

配置每个子网中的一个实例，将其网络接口卡切换到混杂模式并分析网络流量。

Implement Elastic Load Balancing with SSL listeners in front of the web applications.

在 Web 应用程序前面使用 SSL 侦听器实施 Elastic Load Balancing。

Implement a reverse proxy layer in front of web servers and configure IDS/ IPS agents on each reverse proxy server.

在 Web 服务器前面实施反向代理层，并在每个反向代理服务器上配置 IDS/IPS 代理。

content.stem:
Which of the following are valid statements about Amazon S3? (Choose 2 answers)

以下哪些关于 Amazon S3 的正确陈述是？ （选择 2 个答案）

content.text.0:
Amazon S3 provides read-after-write consistency for any type of PUT or DELETE.

Amazon S3 为任何类型的 PUT 或 DELETE 提供写后读一致性。

Consistency is not guaranteed for any type of PUT or DELETE.

不保证任何类型的 PUT 或 DELETE 的一致性。

A successful response to a PUT request only occurs when a complete object is saved.

仅当保存完整的对象时，才会成功响应 PUT 请求。

Partially saved objects are immediately readable with a GET after an overwrite PU.

覆盖 PU 后，可以使用 GET 立即读取部分保存的对象。

S3 provides eventual consistency for overwrite PUTS and DELETE.

S3 为覆盖 PUTS 和 DELETE 提供最终一致性。

content.stem:
Your department creates regular analytics reports from your company's log files All log data is collected in Amazon S3 and processed by daily Amazon Elastic MapReduce (EMR) jobs that generate daily PDF reports and aggregated tables in CSV format for an Amazon Redshift data warehouse. Which of the following alternatives will lower costs without compromising average performance of the system or data integrity for the raw data?

您的部门根据公司的日志文件创建定期分析报告。所有日志数据都收集在 Amazon S3 中，并由每日 Amazon Elastic MapReduce (EMR) 作业进行处理，这些作业为 Amazon Redshift 数据仓库生成每日 PDF 报告和 CSV 格式的聚合表。以下哪种替代方案可以降低成本而不影响系统的平均性能或原始数据的数据完整性？

content.text.0:
Use reduced redundancy storage (RRS) for all data in S3. Use a combination of Spot Instances and Reserved Instances for Amazon EMR jobs. Use Reserved Instances for Amazon Redshift.

对 S3 中的所有数据使用减少冗余存储 (RRS)。对 Amazon EMR 作业使用竞价型实例和预留实例的组合。使用 Amazon Redshift 的预留实例。

Use reduced redundancy storage (RRS) for PDF and .csv data in S3. Add Spot Instances to EMR jobs. Use Spot Instances for Amazon Redshift.

对 S3 中的 PDF 和 .csv 数据使用减少冗余存储 (RRS)。将 Spot 实例添加到 EMR 作业。使用 Amazon Redshift 的 Spot 实例。

Use reduced redundancy storage (RRS) for PDF and .csv data in Amazon S3. Add Spot Instances to Amazon EMR jobs. Use Reserved Instances for Amazon Redshift.

对 Amazon S3 中的 PDF 和 .csv 数据使用减少冗余存储 (RRS)。将 Spot 实例添加到 Amazon EMR 作业。使用 Amazon Redshift 的预留实例。

Use reduced redundancy storage (RRS) for all data in Amazon S3. Add Spot Instances to Amazon EMR jobs. Use Reserved Instances for Amazon Redshift.

A company is running a batch analysis every hour on their main transactional DB, running on an RDS MySQL instance to populate their central Data Warehouse running on Redshift. During the execution of the batch their transactional applications are very slow. When the batch completes they need to update the top management dashboard with the new data. The dashboard is produced by another system running on-premises that is currently started when a manually-sent email notifies that an update is required. The on-premises system cannot be modified because it is managed by another team. How would you optimize this scenario to solve performance issues and automate the process as much as possible?

一家公司每小时在其主事务数据库上运行一次批量分析，该数据库在 RDS MySQL 实例上运行，以填充在 Redshift 上运行的中央数据仓库。在批处理执行期间，它们的事务应用程序非常慢。批次完成后，他们需要使用新数据更新高层管理仪表板。该仪表板由本地运行的另一个系统生成，该系统当前在手动发送的电子邮件通知需要更新时启动。本地系统无法修改，因为它由另一个团队管理。您将如何优化此场景以解决性能问题并尽可能自动化流程？

content.text.0:
Replace RDS with Redshift for the batch analysis and SNS to notify the on-premises system to update the dashboard.

将 RDS 替换为 Redshift 进行批量分析，并使用 SNS 通知本地系统更新仪表板。

Replace RDS with Redshift for the batch analysis and SQS to send a message to the on-premises system to update the dashboard.

将 RDS 替换为 Redshift 以进行批量分析，将 SQS 替换为向本地系统发送消息以更新仪表板。

Create an RDS Read Replica for the batch analysis and SNS to notify the on-premises system to update the dashboard.

创建 RDS 只读副本用于批量分析和 SNS，以通知本地系统更新仪表板。

Create an RDS Read Replica for the batch analysis and SQS to send a message to the on-premises system to update the dashboard.

创建用于批量分析的 RDS 只读副本和 SQS，以将消息发送到本地系统以更新仪表板。

You are in the process of creating a Route 53 DNS failover to direct traffic to two EC2 zones. Obviously, if one fails, you would like Route 53 to direct traffic to the other region. 您正在创建 Route 53 DNS 故障转移以将流量引导至两个 EC2 区域。显然，如果其中一个区域出现故障，您希望 Route 53 将流量引导至另一个区域。每个 Region 都有一个 ELB，其中分布着一些实例。配置 Route 53 运行状况检查的最佳方法是什么？

content.text.0:
Route 53 doesn't support ELB with an internal health check. You need to create your own Route 53 health check of the ELB.

Route 53 不支持具有内部运行状况检查的 ELB。您需要创建自己的 ELB Route 53 运行状况检查。

Route 53 natively supports ELB with an internal health check. Turn 'Evaluate target health' on and 'Associate with Health Check' off and R53 will use the ELB's internal health check.

Route 53 本身支持具有内部运行状况检查的 ELB。打开“评估目标运行状况”并关闭“与运行状况检查关联”，R53 将使用 ELB 的内部运行状况检查。

To serve Web traffic for a popular product your chief financial officer and IT director have purchased 10 ml large heavy utilization Reserved Instances (RIs) evenly spread across two Availability Zones. Route 53 is used to deliver the traffic to an Elastic Load Balancer (ELB). After several months, the product grows even more popular and you need additional capacity. As a result, your company purchases two C3.2xlarge medium utilization RIs. You register the two c3 2xlarge instances with your ELB and quickly find that the ml large instances are at 100% of capacity and the c3 2xlarge instances have significant capacity that's unused. Which option is the most cost effective and uses EC2 capacity most effectively?

为了为流行产品提供 Web 流量，您的首席财务官和 IT 总监购买了 10 毫升大型高利用率预留实例 (RI)，均匀分布在两个可用区中。路由 53 用于将流量传送到 Elastic Load Balancer (ELB)。几个月后，该产品变得更加流行，您需要额外的容量。因此，您的公司购买了两个 C3.2xlarge 中等利用率 RI。您向 ELB 注册了两个 c3 2xlarge 实例，很快发现 ml 大型实例的容量已达到 100%，而 c3 2xlarge 实例有大量未使用的容量。哪种选项最具成本效益并且最有效地利用 EC2 容量？

content.text.0:
Use a separate ELB for each instance type and distribute load to ELBs with Route 53 weighted round robin.

为每个实例类型使用单独的 ELB，并通过 Route 53 加权循环将负载分配到 ELB。

使用基于 Route 53 延迟的路由和运行状况检查，直接将流量路由到 EC2 ml large 和 c3 2xlarge 实例。关闭 ELB。

使用两个 c3 2xlarge 实例配置 ELB，并使用按需自动缩放组最多另外两个 c3.2xlarge 实例。关闭 m1.large 实例。

Amazon Elastic Load Balancing is used to manage traffic on a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances, distributing traffic to instances across all Availability Zones within a region. Amazon Elastic Load Balancing 用于管理 Amazon EC2 实例队列上的流量，将流量分配到区域内所有可用区的实例。 Elastic Load Balancing 具有本地负载均衡器的所有优点，以及多项安全优势。以下哪一项不是 ELB 相对于本地负载均衡器的优势？

ELB uses a four-tier, key-based architecture for encryption.

ELB 使用四层、基于密钥的架构进行加密。

content.stem:
A web company is looking to implement an external payment service into their highly available application deployed in a VPC. Their application EC2 instances are behind a public facing ELB. Auto scaling is used to add additional instances as traffic increases. Under normal load the application runs 2 instances in the Auto Scaling group but at peak it can scale 3x in size. The application instances need to communicate with the payment service over the Internet which requires whitelisting of all public IP addresses used to communicate with it. A maximum of 4 whitelisting IP addresses are allowed at a time and can be added through an API. How should they architect their solution?

一家网络公司正在寻求将外部支付服务实施到部署在 VPC 中的高可用应用程序中。他们的应用程序 EC2 实例位于面向公众的 ELB 后面。自动缩放用于随着流量的增加添加额外的实例。在正常负载下，应用程序在 Auto Scaling 组中运行 2 个实例，但在峰值时，它的大小可以扩展 3 倍。应用程序实例需要通过互联网与支付服务进行通信，这需要将用于与其通信的所有公共 IP 地址列入白名单。一次最多允许 4 个白名单 IP 地址，并且可以通过 API 添加。他们应该如何构建他们的解决方案？

content.text.0:
Route payment requests through two NAT instances setup for High Availability and whitelist the Elastic IP addresses attached to the NAT instances.

通过两个 NAT 实例路由支付请求以实现高可用性，并将附加到 NAT 实例的弹性 IP 地址列入白名单。

Whitelist the VPC Internet Gateway Public IP and route payment requests through the Internet Gateway.

将 VPC 互联网网关公共 IP 列入白名单，并通过互联网网关路由付款请求。

Whitelist the ELB IP addresses and route payment requests from the Application servers through the ELB.

将 ELB IP 地址列入白名单，并通过 ELB 路由来自应用程序服务器的支付请求。

Automatically assign public IP addresses to the application instances in the Auto Scaling group and run a script on boot that adds each instance's public IP address to the payment validation whitelist API.

自动将公共 IP 地址分配给 Auto Scaling 组中的应用程序实例，并在启动时运行脚本，将每个实例的公共 IP 地址添加到支付验证白名单 API。

Deploy ElasticCache in-memory cache running in each Availability Zone.

How would you design a solution to meet the above requirements?

Store the user preference data in S3. Setup a DynamoDB table with an item for each user and an item attribute pointing to the user's S3 object. The mobile application will retrieve the S3 URL from DynamoDB and then access the S3 object directly. Utilize STS, Web identity Federation, and S3 ACLs to authenticate and authorize access.

将用户偏好数据存储在 S3 中。设置一个 DynamoDB 表，其中包含每个用户的项目以及指向用户的 S3 对象的项目属性。移动应用程序将从 DynamoDB 检索 S3 URL，然后直接访问 S3 对象。利用 STS、Web 身份联合和 S3 ACL 来验证和授权访问。

content.stem:
You have deployed a web application targeting a global audience across multiple AWS Regions under the domain name.example.com. You decide to use Route 53 Latency-Based Routing to serve web requests to users from the region closest to the user. To provide business continuity in the event of server downtime you configure weighted record sets associated with two web servers in separate Availability Zones per region. During a DR test you notice that when you disable all web servers in one of the regions Route 53 does not automatically direct all users to the other region. What could be happening? (Choose 2 answers)

您已在域名.example.com 下跨多个 AWS 区域部署了面向全球受众的 Web 应用程序。您决定使用 Route 53 基于延迟的路由来为距离用户最近的区域的用户提供 Web 请求。为了在服务器停机时提供业务连续性，您可以配置与每个区域不同可用区中的两个 Web 服务器关联的加权记录集。在 DR 测试期间，您会注意到，当您禁用其中一个区域中的所有 Web 服务器时，Route 53 不会自动将所有用户定向到另一区域。可能会发生什么？ （选择 2 个答案）

content.text.0:
Latency resource record sets cannot be used in combination with weighted resource record sets.

延迟资源记录集不能与加权资源记录集结合使用。

You did not setup an HTTP health check for one or more of the weighted resource record sets associated with the disabled web servers.

您没有为与禁用的 Web 服务器关联的一个或多个加权资源记录集设置 HTTP 运行状况检查。

The value of the weight associated with the latency alias resource record set in the region with the disabled servers is higher than the weight for the other region.

与服务器已禁用的区域中的延迟别名资源记录集关联的权重值高于其他区域的权重。

One of the two working web servers in the other region did not pass its HTTP health check.

另一个区域中的两个正在运行的 Web 服务器之一未通过其 HTTP 运行状况检查。

You did not set 'Evaluate Target Health' to 'Yes' on the latency alias resource record set associated with example com in the region where you disabled the servers.

您未在与禁用服务器的区域中的示例 com 关联的延迟别名资源记录集上将“评估目标运行状况”设置为“是”。

content.stem:
You've been hired to enhance the overall security posture for a very large e-commerce site. They have a well architected multi-tier application running in a VPC that uses ELBs in front of both the web and the app tier with static assets served directly from S3. They are using a combination of RDS and DynamoDB for their dynamic data and then archiving nightly into S3 for further processing with EMR. They are concerned because they found questionable log entries and suspect someone is attempting to gain unauthorized access. Which approach provides a cost effective scalable mitigation to this kind of attack?

您受雇来增强一家大型电子商务网站的整体安全状况。他们在 VPC 中运行一个架构良好的多层应用程序，该应用程序在 Web 和应用程序层前面使用 ELB，并直接从 S3 提供静态资产。他们将 RDS 和 DynamoDB 组合用于动态数据，然后每晚归档到 S3 中，以便使用 EMR 进行进一步处理。他们之所以担心，是因为他们发现了可疑的日志条目，并怀疑有人试图获得未经授权的访问。哪种方法可以为此类攻击提供经济高效、可扩展的缓解措施？

content.text.0:
Recommend that they lease space at a DirectConnect partner location and establish a 1G DirectConnect connection to their VPC. They would then establish Internet connectivity into their space, filter the traffic in hardware Web Application Firewall (WAF), and then pass the traffic through the DirectConnect connection into their application running in their VPC.

建议他们在 DirectConnect 合作伙伴位置租用空间并建立与其 VPC 的 1G DirectConnect 连接。然后，他们将在其空间中建立互联网连接，在硬件 Web 应用程序防火墙 (WAF) 中过滤流量，然后通过 DirectConnect 连接将流量传递到在其 VPC 中运行的应用程序。

Add previously identified hostile source IPs as an explicit INBOUND DENY NACL to the web tier sub net.

将先前识别的恶意源 IP 作为显式 INBOUND DENY NACL 添加到 Web 层子网。

Add a WAF tier by creating a new ELB and an AutoScaling group of EC2 Instances running a host based WAF. They would redirect Route 53 to resolve to the new WAF tier ELB. The WAF tier would then pass the traffic to the current web tier. The web tier Security Groups would be updated to only allow traffic from the WAF tier Security Group.

通过创建新的 ELB 和运行基于主机的 WAF 的 EC2 实例 AutoScaling 组来添加 WAF 层。他们将重定向 Route 53 以解析到新的 WAF 层 ELB。然后，WAF 层会将流量传递到当前的 Web 层。 Web 层安全组将更新为仅允许来自 WAF 层安全组的流量。

Remove all but TLS 1.2 from the web tier ELB and enable Advanced Protocol Filtering. This will enable the ELB itself to perform WAF functionality.

从 Web 层 ELB 中删除除 TLS 1.2 之外的所有内容，并启用高级协议过滤。这将使 ELB 本身能够执行 WAF 功能。

content.stem:
You are designing the network infrastructure for an application server in Amazon VPC. Users will access all the application instances from the Internet as well as from an on-premises network. The on-premises network is connected to your VPC over an AWS Direct Connect link. How would you design routing to meet the above requirements?

您正在为 Amazon VPC 中的应用程序服务器设计网络基础设施。用户将从 Internet 以及本地网络访问所有应用程序实例。本地网络通过 AWS Direct Connect 链路连接到您的 VPC。您将如何设计路由来满足上述要求？

content.text.0:
Configure a single routing Table with a default route via the Internet gateway. Propagate a default route via BGP on the AWS Direct Connect customer router. Associate the routing table with all VPC subnets.

通过 Internet 网关配置具有默认路由的单个路由表。通过 AWS Direct Connect 客户路由器上的 BGP 传播默认路由。将路由表与所有 VPC 子网关联。

Configure a single routing table with a default route via the internet gateway. Propagate specific routes for the on-premises networks via BGP on the AWS Direct Connect customer router. Associate the routing table with all VPC subnets.

通过互联网网关配置具有默认路由的单个路由表。通过 AWS Direct Connect 客户路由器上的 BGP 传播本地网络的特定路由。将路由表与所有 VPC 子网关联。

Configure a single routing table with two default routes: one to the internet via an Internet gateway, the other to the on-premises network via the VPN gateway. Use this routing table across all subnets in your VPC.

配置具有两条默认路由的单个路由表：一条通过 Internet 网关到达 Internet，另一条通过 VPN 网关到达本地网络。在 VPC 中的所有子网中使用此路由表。

Configure two routing tables: one that has a default route via the Internet gateway and another that has a default route via the VPN gateway. Associate both routing tables with each VPC subnet.

配置两个路由表：一个具有通过 Internet 网关的默认路由，另一个具有通过 VPN 网关的默认路由。将两个路由表与每个 VPC 子网关联。

content.stem:

您有多个 VPN 连接，并希望使用 AWS VPN CloudHub 在站点之间提供安全通信。哪种说法最准确地描述了您必须执行哪些操作才能正确设置此设置？

创建具有多个客户网关的虚拟专用网关，每个网关都有一组唯一的密钥。

创建具有多个客户网关的虚拟公共网关，每个网关都有一个唯一的私有子网。

Create a virtual private gateway with multiple customer gateways, each with unique subnet id.

创建具有多个客户网关的虚拟专用网关，每个网关都有唯一的子网 ID。

A friend wants you to set up a small BitTorrent storage area for him on Amazon S3. You tell him it is highly unlikely that AWS would allow such a thing in their infrastructure. However you decide to investigate. Which of the following statements best describes using BitTorrent with Amazon S3?

一位朋友希望您在 Amazon S3 上为他设置一个小型 BitTorrent 存储区域。你告诉他 AWS 不太可能在他们的基础设施中允许这样的事情。但您决定进行调查。以下哪项陈述最准确地描述了将 BitTorrent 与 Amazon S3 结合使用？

A corporate web application is deployed within an Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) and is connected to the corporate data center via an IPsec VPN. The application must authenticate against the on-premises LDAP server. After authentication, each logged-in user can only access an Amazon Simple Storage Space (S3) keyspace specific to that user. Which two approaches can satisfy these objectives? (Choose 2 answers)

企业 Web 应用程序部署在 Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) 内，并通过 IPsec VPN 连接到企业数据中心。应用程序必须针对本地 LDAP 服务器进行身份验证。身份验证后，每个登录用户只能访问特定于该用户的 Amazon Simple Storage Space (S3) 密钥空间。哪两种方法可以满足这些目标？ （选择 2 个答案）

content.text.0:
Develop an identity broker that authenticates against IAM security Token service to assume an IAM role in order to get temporary AWS security credentials. The application calls the identity broker to get AWS temporary security credentials with access to the appropriate S3 bucket.

开发一个身份代理，根据 IAM 安全令牌服务进行身份验证，以承担 IAM 角色，从而获取临时 AWS 安全凭证。应用程序调用身份代理来获取可访问适当 S3 存储桶的 AWS 临时安全凭证。

The application authenticates against LDAP and retrieves the name of an IAM role associated with the user. The application then calls the IAM Security Token Service to assume that IAM role. The application can use the temporary credentials to access the appropriate S3 bucket.

应用程序根据 LDAP 进行身份验证并检索与用户关联的 IAM 角色的名称。然后，应用程序调用 IAM 安全令牌服务来承担该 IAM 角色。应用程序可以使用临时凭证来访问适当的 S3 存储桶。

Develop an identity broker that authenticates against LDAP and then calls IAM Security Token Service to get IAM federated user credentials. The application calls the identity broker to get IAM federated user credentials with access to the appropriate S3 bucket.

开发一个身份代理，根据 LDAP 进行身份验证，然后调用 IAM 安全令牌服务来获取 IAM 联合用户凭证。应用程序调用身份代理来获取能够访问适当 S3 存储桶的 IAM 联合用户凭证。

The application authenticates against LDAP. The application then calls the AWS identity and Access Management (IAM) Security service to log in to IAM using the LDAP credentials. The application can use the IAM temporary credentials to access the appropriate S3 bucket.

应用程序根据 LDAP 进行身份验证。然后，应用程序调用 AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) 安全服务以使用 LDAP 凭证登录 IAM。应用程序可以使用 IAM 临时凭证来访问适当的 S3 存储桶。

The application authenticates against IAM Security Token Service using the LDAP credentials. The application uses those temporary AWS security credentials to access the appropriate S3 bucket.

应用程序使用 LDAP 凭证针对 IAM 安全令牌服务进行身份验证。应用程序使用这些临时 AWS 安全凭证来访问适当的 S3 存储桶。

Your application provides data transformation services. Files containing data to be transformed are first uploaded to Amazon S3 and then transformed by a fleet of spot EC2 instances. 使用两个 SQS 队列，一个用于高优先级消息，另一个用于默认优先级。转换实例首先轮询高优先级队列；如果没有消息，它们会轮询默认优先级队列。

content.stem:
You need a persistent and durable storage to trace call activity of an IVR (Interactive Voice Response) system. Call duration is mostly in the 2-3 minutes timeframe. Each traced call can be either active or terminated. An external application needs to know each minute the list of currently active calls, which are usually a few calls/second. Put once per month there is a periodic peak up to 1000 calls/second for a few hours. The system is open 24/7 and any downtime should be avoided. Historical data is periodically archived to files. Cost saving is a priority for this project. What database implementation would better fit this scenario, keeping costs as low as possible?

您需要持久且持久的存储来跟踪 IVR（交互式语音应答）系统的呼叫活动。通话时长大多在 2-3 分钟内。每个跟踪的呼叫可以是活动的，也可以是终止的。外部应用程序需要每分钟了解当前活动呼叫的列表，通常是每秒几个呼叫。每月一次，会出现几个小时内高达 1000 次调用/秒的周期性峰值。系统 24/7 全天候开放，应避免任何停机。历史数据定期归档到文件中。节省成本是该项目的首要任务。什么样的数据库实施更适合这种情况，并尽可能降低成本？

content.text.0:
Use RDS Multi-AZ with two tables, one for 'Active calls' and one for 'Terminated calls'. in this way the 'Active calls' table is always small and effective to access.

使用带有两张表的 RDS 多可用区，一张用于“活动呼叫”，一张用于“终止呼叫”。通过这种方式，“活动呼叫”表始终很小并且可以有效访问。

Use DynamoDB with a 'Calls' table and a Global Secondary Index on a 'lsActive' attribute that is present for active calls only in this way the Global Secondary index is sparse and more effective.

将 DynamoDB 与“Calls”表和“lsActive”属性上的全局二级索引结合使用，该属性仅针对活动呼叫而存在，这样全局二级索引就会变得稀疏且更有效。

Use DynamoDB with a 'Calls' table and a Global secondary index on a 'State' attribute that can equal to 'active' or 'terminated' in this way the Global Secondary index can be used for all Items in the table.

将 DynamoDB 与“呼叫”表和“状态”属性上的全局二级索引一起使用，该属性可以等于“活动”或“终止”，这样全局二级索引可用于表中的所有项目。

Use RDS Multi-AZ with a 'CALLS' table and an Indexed 'STATE* field that can be equal to 'ACTIVE' or 'TERMINATED' in this way the SOL query Is optimized by the use of the Index.

将 RDS 多可用区与“CALLS”表和索引“STATE*”字段一起使用，该字段可以等于“ACTIVE”或“TERMINATED”，这样 SOL 查询就可以通过使用索引进行优化。

content.stem:
An AWS customer is deploying an application that is composed of an AutoScaling group of EC2 Instances. The customers security policy requires that every outbound connection from these instances to any other service within the customers Virtual Private Cloud must be authenticated using a unique x 509 certificate that contains the specific instance-id. In addition an x 509 certificates must be designed by the customer's Key management service in order to be trusted for authentication. Which of the following configurations will support these requirements?

AWS 客户正在部署由 EC2 实例 AutoScaling 组组成的应用程序。客户安全策略要求从这些实例到客户虚拟私有云内任何其他服务的每个出站连接都必须使用包含特定实例 ID 的唯一 x 509 证书进行身份验证。此外，x 509 证书必须由客户的密钥管理服务设计，以便可信进行身份验证。以下哪些配置将支持这些要求？

content.text.0:
Configure an IAM Role that grants access to an Amazon S3 object containing a signed certificate and configure the Auto Scaling group to launch instances with this role Have the instances bootstrap get the certificate from Amazon S3 upon first boot.

配置授予对包含签名证书的 Amazon S3 对象的访问权限的 IAM 角色，并将 Auto Scaling 组配置为使用此角色启动实例 让实例引导程序在首次启动时从 Amazon S3 获取证书。

Embed a certificate into the Amazon Machine Image that is used by the Auto Scaling group Have the launched instances generate a certificate signature request with the instance's assigned instance- id to the Key management service for signature.

将证书嵌入到 Auto Scaling 组使用的 Amazon 系统映像中 让已启动的实例使用实例分配的实例 ID 生成证书签名请求，以供密钥管理服务签名。

Configure the Auto Scaling group to send an SNS notification of the launch of a new instance to the trusted key management service. Have the Key management service generate a signed certificate and send it directly to the newly launched instance.

配置 Auto Scaling 组以将新实例启动的 SNS 通知发送到可信密钥管理服务。让密钥管理服务生成签名证书并将其直接发送到新启动的实例。

Configure the launched instances to generate a new certificate upon first boot Have the Key management service poll the AutoScaling group for associated instances and send new instances a certificate signature that contains the specific instance-id.

配置启动的实例以在首次启动时生成新证书 让密钥管理服务轮询 AutoScaling 组以查找关联的实例，并向新实例发送包含特定实例 ID 的证书签名。

Use Amazon S3 server-side encryption with customer-provided keys.

使用 Amazon S3 服务器端加密和客户提供的密钥。

Use Amazon S3 server-side encryption with EC2 key pair.

使用带有 EC2 密钥对的 Amazon S3 服务器端加密。

Use Amazon S3 bucket policies to restrict access to the data at rest.

使用 Amazon S3 存储桶策略来限制对静态数据的访问。

在使用自己的主密钥摄取到 Amazon S3 之前，在客户端对数据进行加密。

Use SSL to encrypt the data while in transit to Amazon S3.

在传输到 Amazon S3 时使用 SSL 对数据进行加密。

content.stem:
You are looking to migrate your Development (Dev) and Test environments to AWS. You have decided to use separate AWS accounts to host each environment. You plan to link each accounts bill to a Master AWS account using Consolidated Billing. To make sure you Keep within budget you would like to implement a way for administrators in the Master account to have access to stop, delete and/or terminate resources in both the Dev and Test accounts. Identify which option will allow you to achieve this goal.

您希望将您的开发 (Dev) 和测试环境迁移到 AWS。您已决定使用单独的 AWS 账户来托管每个环境。您计划使用合并账单将每个账户账单链接到主 AWS 账户。为了确保您的预算不超出预算，您希望为主帐户中的管理员实施一种方法，以便有权停止、删除和/或终止开发帐户和测试帐户中的资源。确定哪个选项可以让您实现这一目标。

content.text.0:
Create IAM users in the Master account with full Admin permissions. Create cross-account roles in the Dev and Test accounts that grant the Master account access to the resources in the account by inheriting permissions from the Master account.

在主账户中创建具有完全管理员权限的 IAM 用户。在开发和测试账户中创建跨账户角色，通过继承主账户的权限来授予主账户访问账户中资源的权限。

Create IAM users and a cross-account role in the Master account that grants full Admin permissions to the Dev and Test accounts.

在主账户中创建 IAM 用户和跨账户角色，向开发和测试账户授予完整的管理员权限。

Create IAM users in the Master account Create cross-account roles in the Dev and Test accounts that have full Admin permissions and grant the Master.

在主账户中创建 IAM 用户 在具有完全管理员权限的开发和测试账户中创建跨账户角色并授予主账户。

Link the accounts using Consolidated Billing. This will give IAM users in the Master account access to resources in the Dev and Test accounts.

使用合并账单链接帐户。这将使主账户中的 IAM 用户能够访问开发和测试账户中的资源。

content.stem:
A customer is running a multi-tier web application farm in a virtual private cloud (VPC) that is not connected to their corporate network. They are connecting to the VPC over the Internet to manage all of their Amazon EC2 instances running in both the public and private subnets. They have only authorized the bastion-security-group with Microsoft Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) access to the application instance security groups, but the company wants to further limit administrative access to all of the instances in the VPC. Which of the following Bastion deployment scenarios will meet this requirement?

客户正在未连接到其公司网络的虚拟私有云 (VPC) 中运行多层 Web 应用程序场。他们通过 Internet 连接到 VPC，以管理在公共子网和私有子网中运行的所有 Amazon EC2 实例。他们仅授权具有 Microsoft 远程桌面协议 (RDP) 的 bastion-security-group 访问应用程序实例安全组，但该公司希望进一步限制对 VPC 中所有实例的管理访问。以下哪些 Bastion 部署场景可以满足此要求？

content.text.0:
Deploy a Windows Bastion host on the corporate network that has RDP access to all instances in the VP.

在企业网络上部署一台 Windows Bastion 主机，该主机对 VP 中的所有实例具有 RDP 访问权限。

Deploy a Windows Bastion host with an Elastic IP address in the public subnet and allow SSH access to the bastion from anywhere.

在公有子网中部署具有弹性 IP 地址的 Windows Bastion 主机，并允许从任何地方通过 SSH 访问堡垒。

Deploy a Windows Bastion host with an Elastic IP address in the private subnet, and restrict RDP access to the bastion from only the corporate public IP addresses.

在私有子网中部署具有弹性 IP 地址的 Windows Bastion 主机，并限制仅从公司公共 IP 地址对堡垒进行 RDP 访问。

Deploy a Windows Bastion host with an auto-assigned Public IP address in the public subnet, and allow RDP access to the bastion from only the corporate public IP addresses.

在公共子网中部署具有自动分配公共 IP 地址的 Windows Bastion 主机，并仅允许从公司公共 IP 地址通过 RDP 访问堡垒。

content.stem:
A company is building a voting system for a popular TV show. Viewers will watch the performances then visit the show's website to vote for their favorite performer. It is expected that in a short period of time after the show has finished the site will receive millions of visitors. The visitors will first login to the site using their Amazon.com credentials and then submit their vote. After the voting is completed the page will display the vote totals. The company needs to build the site such that can handle the rapid influx of traffic while maintaining good performance but also wants to keep costs to a minimum. Which of the design patterns below should they use?

一家公司正在为热门电视节目构建投票系统。观众将观看表演，然后访问节目网站投票选出他们最喜欢的表演者。预计展会结束后的短时间内，该网站将迎来数百万访问者。访问者将首先使用他们的 Amazon.com 凭据登录该网站，然后提交投票。投票结束后，页面会显示投票总数。该公司需要构建能够处理快速涌入的流量的网站，同时保持良好的性能，但也希望将成本降至最低。他们应该使用以下哪种设计模式？

content.text.0:
Use CloudFront and an Elastic Load balancer in front of an auto-scaled set of web servers. The web servers will first call the Login With Amazon service to authenticate the user, then process the user's vote and store the result into a multi-AZ Relational Database Service instance.

在一组自动扩展的 Web 服务器前使用 CloudFront 和 Elastic Load Balancer。 Web 服务器将首先调用 Login With Amazon 服务对用户进行身份验证，然后处理用户的投票并将结果存储到多可用区关系数据库服务实例中。

Use CloudFront and the static website hosting feature of S3 with the Javascript SDK to call the Login With Amazon service to authenticate the user. Use IAM Roles to gain permissions to a DynamoDB table to store the user's vote.

使用 CloudFront 和 S3 的静态网站托管功能以及 Javascript SDK 来调用 Login With Amazon 服务来对用户进行身份验证。使用 IAM 角色获取 DynamoDB 表的权限以存储用户的投票。

Use CloudFront and an Elastic Load Balancer in front of an auto-scaled set of web servers. The web servers will first call the Login with Amazon service to authenticate the user. The web servers will process the user's vote and store the result into a DynamoDB table using IAM Roles for EC2 instances to gain permissions to the DynamoDB table.

在一组自动扩展的 Web 服务器前使用 CloudFront 和 Elastic Load Balancer。 Web 服务器将首先调用 Login with Amazon 服务来对用户进行身份验证。 Web 服务器将处理用户的投票，并使用 EC2 实例的 IAM 角色将结果存储到 DynamoDB 表中，以获得 DynamoDB 表的权限。

Use CloudFront and an Elastic Load Balancer in front of an auto-scaled set of web servers. The web servers will first call the Login with Amazon service to authenticate the user. The web servers will process the user's vote and store the result into an SQS queue using IAM Roles for EC2 Instances to gain permissions to the SQS queue. A set of application servers will then retrieve the items from the queue and store the result into a DynamoDB table.

在一组自动扩展的 Web 服务器前使用 CloudFront 和 Elastic Load Balancer。 Web 服务器将首先调用 Login with Amazon 服务来对用户进行身份验证。 Web 服务器将处理用户的投票，并使用 EC2 实例的 IAM 角色将结果存储到 SQS 队列中，以获得 SQS 队列的权限。然后，一组应用程序服务器将从队列中检索项目并将结果存储到 DynamoDB 表中。

content.stem:
You are designing a photo sharing mobile app. The application will store all pictures in a single Amazon S3 bucket. Users will upload pictures from their mobile device directly to Amazon S3 and will be able to view and download their own pictures directly from Amazon S3. You want to configure security to handle potentially millions of users in the most secure manner possible. What should your server-side application do when a new user registers on the photo sharing mobile application?

您正在设计一个照片共享移动应用程序。该应用程序会将所有图片存储在单个 Amazon S3 存储桶中。用户将移动设备上的图片直接上传到 Amazon S3，并且可以直接从 Amazon S3 查看和下载自己的图片。您希望配置安全性以尽可能最安全的方式处理潜在的数百万用户。当新用户在照片共享移动应用程序上注册时，您的服务器端应用程序应该做什么？

content.text.0:
Create an IAM user. Update the bucket policy with appropriate permissions for the IAM user. Generate an access key and secret key for the IAM user, store them in the mobile app and use these credentials to access Amazon S3.

创建 IAM 用户。使用 IAM 用户的适当权限更新存储桶策略。为 IAM 用户生成访问密钥和秘密密钥，将它们存储在移动应用程序中并使用这些凭证访问 Amazon S3。

Create an IAM user. Assign appropriate permissions to the IAM user. Generate an access key and secret key for the IAM user, store them in the mobile app and use these credentials to access Amazon S3.

创建 IAM 用户。为 IAM 用户分配适当的权限。为 IAM 用户生成访问密钥和秘密密钥，将它们存储在移动应用程序中并使用这些凭证访问 Amazon S3。

Create a set of long-term credentials using AWS Security Token Service with appropriate permissions. Store these credentials in the mobile app and use them to access Amazon S3.

使用具有适当权限的 AWS Security Token Service 创建一组长期凭证。将这些凭据存储在移动应用程序中并使用它们来访问 Amazon S3。

Record the user's information in Amazon RDS and create a role in IAM with appropriate permissions. When the user uses their mobile app, create temporary credentials using the AWS Security Token Service `AssumeRole` function. Store these credentials in the mobile app's memory and use them to access Amazon S3. Generate new credentials the next time the user runs the mobile app.

在 Amazon RDS 中记录用户的信息，并在 IAM 中创建具有适当权限的角色。当用户使用其移动应用程序时，使用 AWS Security Token Service“AssumeRole”函数创建临时凭证。将这些凭据存储在移动应用程序的内存中，并使用它们来访问 Amazon S3。用户下次运行移动应用程序时生成新凭据。

Record the user's information in Amazon DynamoDB. When the user uses their mobile app, create temporary credentials using AWS Security Token Service with appropriate permissions. Store these credentials in the mobile app's memory and use them to access Amazon S3. Generate new credentials the next time the user runs the mobile app.

在 Amazon DynamoDB 中记录用户的信息。当用户使用其移动应用程序时，使用具有适当权限的 AWS Security Token Service 创建临时凭证。将这些凭据存储在移动应用程序的内存中，并使用它们来访问 Amazon S3。用户下次运行移动应用程序时生成新凭据。

content.text.0:

content.stem:
You have launched an EC2 instance with four (4) 500 GB EBS Provisioned IOPS volumes attached. The EC2 instance is EBS-Optimized and supports 500 Mbps throughput between EC2 and EBS. The four EBS volumes are configured as a single RAID 0 device, and each Provisioned IOPS volume is provisioned with 4,000IOPS (4,000 16KB reads or writes), for a total of 16,000 random IOPS on the instance. The EC2 instance initially delivers the expected 16,000 IOPS random read and write performance. Sometime later, in order to increase the total random I/O performance of the instance, you add an additional two 500 GB EBS Provisioned IOPS volumes to the RAID. Each volume is provisioned to 4,000 IOPs like the original four, for a total of 24,000 IOPS on the EC2 instance. Monitoring shows that the EC2 instance CPU utilization increased from 50% to 70%, but the total random IOPS measured at the instance level does not increase at all. What is the problem and a valid solution?

您已启动一个附加了四 (4) 个 500 GB EBS 预配置 IOPS 卷的 EC2 实例。 EC2 实例经过 EBS 优化，支持 EC2 和 EBS 之间的 500 Mbps 吞吐量。四个 EBS 卷配置为单个 RAID 0 设备，每个预置 IOPS 卷均预配 4,000 IOPS（4,000 次 16KB 读取或写入），实例上的随机 IOPS 总数为 16,000。 EC2 实例最初提供预期的 16,000 IOPS 随机读写性能。一段时间后，为了提高实例的总随机 I/O 性能，您可以向 RAID 添加两个额外的 500 GB EBS 预配置 IOPS 卷。每个卷都像原来的四个卷一样配置为 4,000 IOPS，在 EC2 实例上总共提供 24,000 IOPS。监控显示，EC2 实例 CPU 利用率从 50%增加到 70%，但在实例级别测量的总随机 IOPS 根本没有增加。问题是什么以及有效的解决方案？

content.text.0:
Larger storage volumes support higher Provisioned IOPS rates; increase the provisioned volume storage of each of the 6 EBS volumes to 1TB.

更大的存储卷支持更高的预配置 IOPS 速率；将 6 个 EBS 卷中每个卷的预配置卷存储增加到 1TB。

The EBS-Optimized throughput limits the total IOPS that can be utilized; use an EBS Optimized instance that provides larger throughput. Mo

EBS-Optimized 吞吐量限制了可以利用的总 IOPS；使用提供更大吞吐量的 EBS 优化实例。莫

Small block sizes cause performance degradation, limiting the I/O throughput; configure the instance device driver and filesystem to use 64KB blocks to increase throughput.

小块大小会导致性能下降，限制 I/O 吞吐量；配置实例设备驱动程序和文件系统以使用 64KB 块来提高吞吐量。

The standard EBS Instance root volume limits the total IOPS rate; change the instance root volume to also be a 500GB 4,000 Provisioned IOPS volume.

标准 EBS 实例根卷限制总 IOPS 速率；将实例根卷更改为 500GB 4,000 预配置 IOPS 卷。

RAID 0 only scales linearly to about 4 devices; use RAID 0 with 4 EBS Provisioned IOPS volumes, but increase each Provisioned IOPS EBS volume to 6,000 IOPS.

RAID 0 只能线性扩展至大约 4 个设备；将 RAID 0 与 4 个 EBS 预配置 IOPS 卷结合使用，但将每个预配置 IOPS EBS 卷增加到 6,000 IOPS。

You have a web application running on six Amazon EC2 instances, consuming about 45% of resources on each instance. You are using auto-scaling to make sure that six instances are running at all times. The number of requests this application processes is consistent and does not experience spikes. The application is critical to your business and you want high availability at all times. You want the load to be distributed evenly between all instances. You also want to use the same Amazon Machine Image (AMI) for all instances. Which of the following architectural choices should you make?

您有一个 Web 应用程序在六个 Amazon EC2 实例上运行，每个实例消耗大约 45% 的资源。您正在使用自动扩展来确保六个实例始终在运行。此应用程序处理的请求数量是一致的并且不会出现峰值。该应用程序对您的业务至关重要，并且您希望始终保持高可用性。您希望负载在所有实例之间均匀分布。您还希望对所有实例使用相同的 Amazon 系统映像 (AMI)。您应该做出以下哪些架构选择？

content.text.0:
Deploy 6 EC2 instances in one Availability Zone and use Amazon Elastic Load Balancer.

在 1 个可用区中部署 6 个 EC2 实例并使用 Amazon Elastic Load Balancer。

content.stem:
An ERP application is deployed across multiple AZs in a single region. In the event of failure, the Recovery Time Objective (RTO) must be less than 3 hours, and the Recovery Point Objective (RPO) must be 15 minutes. The customer realizes that data corruption occurred roughly 1.5 hours ago. What DR strategy could be used to achieve this RTO and RPO in the event of this kind of failure?

ERP 应用程序部署在单个区域的多个可用区。如果发生故障，恢复时间目标 (RTO) 必须少于 3 小时，恢复点目标 (RPO) 必须为 15 分钟。客户意识到大约 1.5 小时前发生了数据损坏。如果发生此类故障，可以使用什么灾难恢复策略来实现 RTO 和 RPO？

content.text.0:
Take hourly DB backups to S3, with transaction logs stored in S3 every 5 minutes.

每小时将数据库备份到 S3，每 5 分钟将事务日志存储在 S3 中。

Use synchronous database master-slave replication between two Availability Zones.

在两个可用区之间使用同步数据库主从复制。

Take hourly DB backups to EC2 Instance store volumes with transaction logs stored in S3 every 5 minutes.

每小时将数据库备份到 EC2 实例存储卷，并每 5 分钟将事务日志存储在 S3 中。

Take 15 minute DB backups stored in Glacier with transaction logs stored in S3 every 5 minutes.

每 5 分钟在 Glacier 中存储 15 分钟的数据库备份，并在 S3 中存储事务日志。

You are wondering whether Amazon Route 53 can do this. Which statement below is correct in regards to Amazon Route 53?

在 AWS 上为客户部署新网站后，他询问您是否可以对其进行设置，以便在出现故障时可以自动重定向到他存储在其他地方的专用服务器上的备份网站。您想知道 Amazon Route 53 是否可以做到这一点。关于 Amazon Route 53，以下哪项陈述是正确的？

content.stem:
You are migrating a legacy client-server application to AWS. The application responds to a specific DNS domain (e.g. <www.example.com>) and has a 2-tier architecture, with multiple application servers and a database server. Remote clients use TCP to connect to the application servers. The application servers need to know the IP address of the clients in order to function properly and are currently taking that information from the TCP socket. A Multi-AZ RDS MySQL instance will be used for the database. During the migration you can change the application code, but you have to file a change request. How would you implement the architecture on AWS in order to maximize scalability and high availability?

您正在将旧版客户端服务器应用程序迁移到 AWS。该应用程序响应特定的 DNS 域（例如 <www.example.com>），并具有 2 层架构，具有多个应用程序服务器和一个数据库服务器。远程客户端使用 TCP 连接到应用程序服务器。应用程序服务器需要知道客户端的 IP 地址才能正常运行，并且当前正在从 TCP 套接字获取该信息。数据库将使用多可用区 RDS MySQL 实例。在迁移过程中，您可以更改应用程序代码，但必须提交更改请求。您将如何在 AWS 上实施架构以最大限度地提高可扩展性和高可用性？

content.text.0:
File a change request to implement Alias Resource support in the application. Use Route 53 Alias Resource Record to distribute load on two application servers in different AZs.

提交更改请求以在应用程序中实施 Alias Resource 支持。使用 Route 53 别名资源记录将负载分配到不同可用区的两台应用程序服务器上。

File a change request to implement Latency Based Routing support in the application. Use Route 53 with Latency Based Routing enabled to distribute load on two application servers in different AZs.

提交变更请求以在应用程序中实现基于延迟的路由支持。使用启用了基于延迟的路由的 Route 53 在不同可用区的两台应用程序服务器上分配负载。

File a change request to implement Cross-Zone support in the application. Use an ELB with a TCP Listener and Cross-Zone Load Balancing enabled, two application servers in different AZs.

提交变更请求以在应用程序中实现跨区域支持。使用启用了 TCP 侦听器和跨区域负载均衡的 ELB，两个应用程序服务器位于不同的可用区。

File a change request to implement Proxy Protocol support in the application. Use an ELB with a TCP Listener and Proxy Protocol enabled to distribute load on two application servers in different AZs.

提交变更请求以在应用程序中实现代理协议支持。使用启用了 TCP 侦听器和代理协议的 ELB 将负载分配到不同可用区的两个应用程序服务器上。

content.stem:
Your system recently experienced down time during the troubleshooting process. You found that a new administrator mistakenly terminated several production EC2 instances. Which of the following strategies will help prevent a similar situation in the future? The administrator still must be able to: Launch, start stop, and terminate development resources. Launch and start production instances.

您的系统最近在故障排除过程中经历了停机。您发现新管理员错误地终止了多个生产 EC2 实例。以下哪项策略将有助于防止将来出现类似情况？管理员仍然必须能够： 启动、启动、停止和终止开发资源。启动并启动生产实例。

content.text.0:
Create an IAM user, which is not allowed to terminate instances by leveraging production EC2 termination protection.

创建一个 IAM 用户，不允许该用户利用生产 EC2 终止保护来终止实例。

Leverage resource based tagging along with an IAM user, which can prevent specific users from terminating production EC2 resources.

利用基于资源的标记和 IAM 用户，这可以防止特定用户终止生产 EC2 资源。

Leverage EC2 termination protection and multi-factor authentication, which together require users to authenticate before terminating EC2 instances.

利用 EC2 终止保护和多因素身份验证，两者一起要求用户在终止 EC2 实例之前进行身份验证。

Create an IAM user and apply an IAM role which prevents users from terminating production EC2 instances.

创建 IAM 用户并应用 IAM 角色，以防止用户终止生产 EC2 实例。

content.stem:
You have just set up a large site for a client which involved a huge database which you set up with Amazon RDS to run as a Multi-AZ deployment. You now start to worry about what will happen if the database instance fails. Which statement best describes how this database will function if there is a database failure?

您刚刚为客户设置了一个大型站点，其中涉及一个巨大的数据库，您使用 Amazon RDS 设置该数据库以作为多可用区部署运行。您现在开始担心如果数据库实例失败会发生什么。哪句话最能描述数据库发生故障时该数据库将如何运行？

content.text.0:
Updates to your DB Instance are synchronously replicated across Availability Zones to the standby in order to keep both in sync and protect your latest database updates against DB Instance failure.

对数据库实例的更新会跨可用区同步复制到备用数据库实例，以便保持同步并保护最新的数据库更新免受数据库实例故障的影响。

Your database will not resume operation without manual administrative intervention.

如果没有手动管理干预，您的数据库将不会恢复运行。

Updates to your DB Instance are asynchronously replicated across Availability Zones to the standby in order to keep both in sync and protect your latest database updates against DB Instance failure.

对数据库实例的更新会跨可用区异步复制到备用数据库实例，以便保持同步并保护最新的数据库更新免受数据库实例故障的影响。

Updates to your DB Instance are synchronously replicated across S3 to the standby in order to keep both in sync and protect your latest database updates against DB Instance failure.

对数据库实例的更新会通过 S3 同步复制到备用数据库，以便保持同步并保护最新的数据库更新免受数据库实例故障的影响。

content.stem:
Your company has an on-premises multi-tier PHP web application, which recently experienced downtime due to a large burst in web traffic due to a company announcement. Over the coming days, you are expecting similar announcements to drive similar unpredictable bursts, and are looking to find ways to quickly improve your infrastructure's ability to handle unexpected increases in traffic. The application currently consists of 2 tiers: a web tier which consists of a load balancer and several Linux Apache web servers, as well as a database tier which hosts a Linux server hosting a MySQL database. Which scenario below will provide full site functionality, while helping to improve the ability of your application in the short timeframe required?

您的公司有一个本地多层 PHP Web 应用程序，该应用程序最近因公司公告导致 Web 流量激增而出现停机。在接下来的几天里，您预计类似的公告会推动类似的不可预测的突发事件，并寻求快速提高基础设施处理意外流量增长的能力的方法。该应用程序当前由 2 层组成：Web 层由负载均衡器和多个 Linux Apache Web 服务器组成，以及数据库层，其中托管 Linux 服务器并托管 MySQL 数据库。下面哪种方案将提供完整的站点功能，同时帮助在所需的短时间内提高应用程序的能力？

content.text.0:
Failover environment: Create an S3 bucket and configure it for website hosting. Migrate your DNS to Route 53 using zone file import, and leverage Route 53 DNS failover to failover to the S3 hosted website.

故障转移环境：创建 S3 存储桶并将其配置为网站托管。使用区域文件导入将您的 DNS 迁移到 Route 53，并利用 Route 53 DNS 故障转移将故障转移到 S3 托管网站。

Hybrid environment: Create an AMI, which can be used to launch web servers in EC2. Create an Auto Scaling group, which uses the AMI to scale the web tier based on incoming traffic. Leverage Elastic Load Balancing to balance traffic between on-premises web servers and those hosted in AWS.

混合环境：创建 AMI，可用于在 EC2 中启动 Web 服务器。创建 Auto Scaling 组，该组使用 AMI 根据传入流量扩展 Web 层。利用 Elastic Load Balancing 平衡本地 Web 服务器与 AWS 中托管的服务器之间的流量。

Offload traffic from on-premises environment: Setup a CloudFront distribution, and configure CloudFront to cache objects from a custom origin. Choose to customize your object cache behavior, and select a TTL that objects should exist in cache.

Your firm has uploaded a large amount of aerial image data to S3. In the past, in your on-premises environment, you used a dedicated group of servers to often process this data and used Rabbit MQ, an open source messaging system to get job information to the servers. Once processed, the data would go to tape and be shipped offsite. Your manager told you to stay with the current design, and leverage AWS archival storage and messaging services to minimize cost. Which is correct?

您的公司已将大量航拍图像数据上传到 S3。过去，在本地环境中，您经常使用一组专用服务器来处理这些数据，并使用 Rabbit MQ（一种开源消息传递系统）将作业信息发送到服务器。处理完毕后，数据将被写入磁带并异地传送。您的经理告诉您保持当前的设计，并利用 AWS 存档存储和消息传递服务来最大限度地降低成本。哪个是正确的？

Use SQS for passing job messages. Use Cloud Watch alarms to terminate EC2 worker instances when they become idle. Once data is processed, change the storage class of the S3 objects to Reduced Redundancy Storage.

使用 SQS 传递作业消息。使用 Cloud Watch 警报在 EC2 工作线程实例空闲时终止它们。处理数据后，将 S3 对象的存储类别更改为减少冗余存储。

Setup Auto-Scaled workers triggered by queue depth that use spot instances to process messages in SQS. Once data is processed, change the storage class of the S3 objects to Reduced Redundancy Storage.

Use SNS to pass job messages. Use Cloud Watch alarms to terminate spot worker instances when they become idle. Once data is processed, change the storage class of the S3 object to Glacier.

In addition, the storage layer must be able to survive the loss of an individual disk, EC2 instance, or Availability Zone without any data loss. The volume you provide must have a capacity of at least 3 TB. Which of the following designs will meet these objectives?

您被要求为应用程序设计存储层。该应用程序需要至少 100,000 IOPS 的磁盘性能。此外，存储层必须能够承受单个磁盘、EC2 实例或可用区丢失的影响，而不会丢失任何数据。您提供的卷的容量必须至少为 3 TB。以下哪些设计可以满足这些目标？

content.text.0:
Instantiate a c3.8xlarge instance in us-east-1. Provision 4x1TB EBS volumes, attach them to the instance, and configure them as a single RAID 5 volume. Ensure that EBS snapshots are performed every 15 minutes.

在 us-east-1 中实例化一个 c3.8xlarge 实例。配置 4x1TB EBS 卷，将它们附加到实例，并将它们配置为单个 RAID 5 卷。确保每 15 分钟执行一次 EBS 快照。

Instantiate a c3.8xlarge instance in us-east-1. Provision 3xlTB EBS volumes, attach them to the Instance, and configure them as a single RAID 0 volume. Ensure that EBS snapshots are performed every 15 minutes.

在 us-east-1 中实例化一个 c3.8xlarge 实例。配置 3xlTB EBS 卷，将它们附加到实例，并将它们配置为单个 RAID 0 卷。确保每 15 分钟执行一次 EBS 快照。

Provision 3x1TB EBS volumes, attach them to the instance, and configure them as a second RAID 0 volume. Configure synchronous, block-level replication from the ephemeral-backed volume to the EBS-backed volume.

在 us-east-1a 中实例化一个 i2.8xlarge 实例。使用实例附带的四个 800GB SSD 临时磁盘创建 RAID 0 卷。配置 3x1TB EBS 卷，将它们附加到实例，并将它们配置为第二个 RAID 0 卷。配置从临时支持的卷到 EBS 支持的卷的同步块级复制。

Instantiate a c3.8xlarge instance in us-east-1. Provision an AWS Storage Gateway and configure it for 3 TB of storage and 100,000 IOPS. Attach the volume to the instance.

在 us-east-1 中实例化一个 c3.8xlarge 实例。配置 AWS Storage Gateway 并将其配置为 3 TB 存储和 100,000 IOPS。将卷附加到实例。

Instantiate an i2.8xlarge instance in us-east-1a. Create a RAID 0 volume using the four 800GB SSD ephemeral disks provided with the instance. Configure synchronous, block-level replication to an identically configured instance in us-east-1b.

在 us-east-1a 中实例化一个 i2.8xlarge 实例。使用实例附带的四个 800GB SSD 临时磁盘创建 RAID 0 卷。配置同步块级复制到 us-east-1b 中配置相同的实例。

The web, application and database servers are deployed across two Availability Zones (AZs). You also deploy an ELB in front of the two web servers, and use Route 53 for DNS. Web traffic gradually increases in the first few days following the deployment, so you attempt to double the number of instances in each tier of the application to handle the new load. Unfortunately some of these new instances fail to launch. Which of the following could be the root cause? (Choose 2 answers)

您已在 CIDR 块为 10.0.0.0/28 的 VPC 中部署了三层 Web 应用程序。您最初部署两台 Web 服务器、两台应用程序服务器、两台数据库服务器和一个 NAT 实例，总共七个 EC2 实例。 Web、应用程序和数据库服务器跨两个可用区 (AZ) 部署。您还在两个 Web 服务器前面部署 ELB，并使用 Route 53 作为 DNS。部署后的最初几天，Web 流量逐渐增加，因此您尝试将应用程序每一层中的实例数量加倍以处理新负载。不幸的是，其中一些新实例无法启动。以下哪一项可能是根本原因？ （选择 2 个答案）

content.text.0:
AWS reserves the first and the last private IP address in each subnet's CIDR block so you do not have enough addresses left to launch all of the new EC2 instances.

AWS 保留每个子网 CIDR 块中的第一个和最后一个私有 IP 地址，因此您没有足够的地址来启动所有新的 EC2 实例。

您的 VPC 的互联网网关 (IGW) 已进行扩展，添加了更多实例来应对流量高峰，减少了新实例启动时可用的私有 IP 地址的数量。

ELB 已进行了扩展，添加了更多实例来应对流量高峰，减少了新实例启动时可用的私有 IP 地址的数量。

AWS 在每个子网的 CIDR 块中为 Route 53 保留一个 IP 地址，因此您没有足够的地址来启动所有新的 EC2 实例。

AWS 保留每个子网 CIDR 块中的前四个和最后一个 IP 地址，因此您没有足够的地址来启动所有新的 EC2 实例。

通过网关存储，您可以将数据存储在 Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) 中，并在本地保留经常访问的数据子集的副本。网关缓存使您能够将本地网关配置为在本地存储所有数据，然后将该数据的时间点快照异步备份到 Amazon S3。

An accountant asks you to design a small VPC network for him and, due to the nature of his business, just needs something where the workload on the network will be low, and dynamic data will be accessed infrequently. Being an accountant, low cost is also a major factor. Which EBS volume type would best suit his requirements?

一位会计师要求您为他设计一个小型 VPC 网络，由于他的业务性质，只需要网络工作负载较低且动态数据访问频率较低的网络。作为会计师，低成本也是一个主要因素。哪种 EBS 卷类型最适合他的要求？

content.text.0:
Magnetic.

磁的。

Any, as they all perform the same and cost the same.

任何，因为它们的性能相同且成本相同。

General Purpose (SSD).

通用（SSD）。

content.stem:
Your company currently has a 2-tier web application running in an on-premises data center. You have experienced several infrastructure failures in the past two months resulting in significant financial losses. Your CIO is strongly agreeing to move the application to AWS. While working on achieving buy-in from the other company executives, he asks you to develop a disaster recovery plan to help improve Business continuity in the short term. He specifies a target Recovery Time Objective (RTO) of 4 hours and a Recovery Point Objective (RPO) of 1 hour or less. He also asks you to implement the solution within 2 weeks. Your database is 200GB in size and you have a 20Mbps Internet connection. How would you do this while minimizing costs?

您的公司当前有一个在本地数据中心运行的 2 层 Web 应用程序。在过去的两个月中，您经历了多次基础设施故障，导致了重大的财务损失。您的 CIO 强烈同意将应用程序迁移到 AWS。在努力获得其他公司高管的支持时，他要求您制定灾难恢复计划，以帮助提高短期内的业务连续性。他指定了 4 小时的目标恢复时间目标 (RTO) 和 1 小时或更短的恢复点目标 (RPO)。他还要求你在两周内实施该解决方案。您的数据库大小为 200GB，并且您拥有 20Mbps 的互联网连接。您将如何做到这一点，同时最大限度地降低成本？

content.text.0:
Create an EBS backed private AMI which includes a fresh install of your application. Develop a CloudFormation template which includes your AMI and the required EC2, AutoScaling, and ELB resources to support deploying the application across Multiple Availability Zones. Asynchronously replicate transactions from your on-premises database to a database instance in AWS across a secure VPN connection.

创建 EBS 支持的私有 AMI，其中包括应用程序的全新安装。开发一个 CloudFormation 模板，其中包括您的 AMI 以及所需的 EC2、AutoScaling 和 ELB 资源，以支持跨多个可用区部署应用程序。通过安全 VPN 连接将事务从本地数据库异步复制到 AWS 中的数据库实例。

Deploy your application on EC2 instances within an Auto Scaling group across multiple availability zones. Asynchronously replicate transactions from your on-premises database to a database instance in AWS across a secure VPN connection.

在跨多个可用区的 Auto Scaling 组内的 EC2 实例上部署您的应用程序。通过安全 VPN 连接将事务从本地数据库异步复制到 AWS 中的数据库实例。

Create an EBS backed private AMI which includes a fresh install of your application. Setup a script in your data center to backup the local database every 1 hour and to encrypt and copy the resulting file to an S3 bucket using multi-part upload.

创建 EBS 支持的私有 AMI，其中包括应用程序的全新安装。在数据中心设置一个脚本，每 1 小时备份一次本地数据库，并使用分段上传加密生成的文件并将其复制到 S3 存储桶。

Install your application on a compute-optimized EC2 instance capable of supporting the application's average load. Synchronously replicate transactions from your on-premises database to a database instance in AWS across a secure Direct Connect connection.

将您的应用程序安装在能够支持应用程序平均负载的计算优化型 EC2 实例上。通过安全的 Direct Connect 连接将事务从本地数据库同步复制到 AWS 中的数据库实例。

content.stem:
A customer implemented AWS Storage Gateway with a gateway-cached volume at their main office. An event takes the link between the main and branch office offline. Which methods will enable the branch office to access their data? (Choose 3 answers)

客户在其总部实施了带有网关缓存卷的 AWS Storage Gateway。某个事件使总公司和分支机构之间的链接脱机。哪些方法将使分支机构能够访问其数据？ （选择 3 个答案）

content.text.0:
Use a HTTPS GET to the Amazon S3 bucket where the files are located.

使用 HTTPS GET 访问文件所在的 Amazon S3 存储桶。

Restore by implementing a lifecycle policy on the Amazon S3 bucket.

通过在 Amazon S3 存储桶上实施生命周期策略进行恢复。

Make an Amazon Glacier Restore API ca ll to load the files into another Amazon S3 bucket within four to six hours.

进行 Amazon Glacier 恢复 API 调用，在四到六个小时内将文件加载到另一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中。

Launch a new AWS Storage Gateway instance AMI in Amazon EC2, and restore from a gateway snapshot.

在 Amazon EC2 中启动新的 AWS Storage Gateway 实例 AMI，并从网关快照恢复。

Create an Amazon EBS volume from a gateway snapshot, and mount it to an Amazon EC2 instance.

从网关快照创建 Amazon EBS 卷，并将其挂载到 Amazon EC2 实例。

Launch an AWS Storage Gateway virtual iSCSI device at the branch office, and restore from a gateway snapshot.

在分支机构启动 AWS Storage Gateway 虚拟 iSCSI 设备，并从网关快照恢复。

content.stem:
Your customer is willing to consolidate their log streams (access logs, application logs, security logs, etc.) in one single system. Once consolidated, the customer wants to analyze these logs in real-time based on heuristics. From time to time, the customer needs to validate heuristics, which requires going back to data samples extracted from the last 12 hours. What is the best approach to meet your customer's requirements?

您的客户愿意将他们的日志流（访问日志、应用程序日志、安全日志等）整合到一个系统中。整合后，客户希望根据启发法实时分析这些日志。有时，客户需要验证启发式方法，这需要返回过去 12 小时提取的数据样本。满足客户要求的最佳方法是什么？

content.text.0:
Send all the log events to Amazon SQS. Setup an Auto Scaling group of EC2 servers to consume the logs and apply the heuristics.

将所有日志事件发送到 Amazon SQS。设置 EC2 服务器的 Auto Scaling 组来使用日志并应用启发式方法。

Send all the log events to Amazon Kinesis. Develop a client process to apply heuristics on the logs.

将所有日志事件发送到 Amazon Kinesis。开发一个客户端流程以对日志应用启发式方法。

Configure Amazon Cloud Trail to receive custom logs. Use EMR to apply heuristics to the logs.

配置 Amazon Cloud Trail 以接收自定义日志。使用 EMR 对日志应用启发式方法。

Setup an Auto Scaling group of EC2 syslogd servers. Store the logs on S3. Use EMR to apply heuristics on the logs.

设置 EC2 syslogd 服务器的 Auto Scaling 组。将日志存储在 S3 上。使用 EMR 对日志应用启发式方法。

‘Key’的字符串值可以加上 laws 前缀吗？

You are configuring your company's application to use Auto Scaling and need to move user state information. Which of the following AWS services provides a shared data store with durability and low latency?

您正在将公司的应用程序配置为使用 Auto Scaling，并且需要移动用户状态信息。以下哪项 AWS 服务提供了具有持久性和低延迟的共享数据存储？
